name: David McAllister - § 93/2
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: ‘notes that some progress on the CFSP can be made by using the provisions in the existing Treaties, such as the ‘passerelle clause’; stresses that the Treaties should provide specifically for the possibility of establishing a European Defence Union, and that the VP/HR should be supported in her efforts to become the main external representative of the EU in international forums;’
